description: Remove ** and __ strong emphasis, keeping the inner text; never edits inside code, math, YAML, tables, wikilinks, or URLs.
Replace em dashes and connector en dashes with a configured separator (default comma plus space), preserving numeric en dash ranges.

Normalize each ATX heading level to a chosen case style (camelCase, First letter, kebab-case, Title Case, underscore_formatted); levels left unset are untouched, and headings in code, math, tables, or frontmatter are never edited.
Replace selected expanded English phrases with contractions, preserving capitalization and protected Markdown regions.
Flag hard-wrapped prose lines inside a paragraph that could be unwrapped into a single line; enable join-paragraph-lines-fix to apply the rewrite.

Unwrap hard-wrapped prose lines inside a paragraph into a single line, leaving lists, blockquotes, tables, headings, code, math, YAML, and intentional breaks untouched; destructive opt-in twin of join-paragraph-lines.
Flag simple one-level bullet lists that could be comma-joined prose; enable prose-list-to-sentences-fix to apply the rewrite.
Convert simple one-level bullet lists into comma-joined prose sentences; destructive opt-in twin of prose-list-to-sentences.
Normalize blank lines between blocks to a fixed count (0, 1, or 2); trims leading and trailing blank lines and preserves blank lines inside code, math, tables, and frontmatter.
Normalize unordered list bullets to a single marker ("- " or "* ") and, by default, remove blank lines between items; ordered lists, thematic breaks, and masked blocks are untouched.
Declarative code checks over fenced code blocks (patterns from lynter.yaml code-checks; never executes code).
Apply fixing code checks (those with fix.replacement) inside fenced code blocks.
Collapse runs of blank lines outside code, math, and frontmatter to a single blank line.
Remove duplicate values from YAML arrays, case sensitively.
Add a default language to opening code fences that have none.
Make emphasis delimiters consistently asterisks or underscores.
Ensure a blank line before and after blockquotes and callouts.
Ensure a blank line before and after fenced code blocks.
Ensure a blank line before and after horizontal rules.
Ensure a blank line before and after display math blocks.
Ensure a blank line before and after tables.
Quote frontmatter values that contain a colon and space, single quotes, or double quotes.
Remove leading hashtags from tags in frontmatter.
Format YAML arrays, tags, and aliases as single-line arrays, multi-line lists, or strings.
Heading levels may only go one level deeper than their parent heading.
Ensure a blank line before and after every heading.
Remove whitespace before a heading marker so the line is a heading.
Add missing frontmatter attributes from a template.
End the document with exactly one line break and no trailing blank lines.
Move inline body tags into the frontmatter tags list.
Wrap bare URLs in angle brackets so they stay links.
Normalize ordered list numbering (ascending or lazy) and the character after the number.
Replace three consecutive periods with the ellipsis character.
Make single and double quotes in body text either all straight or all smart.
Delete list items that have a marker but no content.
Collapse two or more consecutive spaces inside a line to one space.
Strip configured punctuation from the end of headings, keeping HTML entities.
Delete listed keys, with their values, from the frontmatter.
Use exactly one space after list markers and after checkboxes.
Make strong delimiters consistently double asterisks or double underscores.
Remove spaces and tabs at the end of every line.
Use one bullet marker for all unordered list items.
Sort frontmatter keys into the configured order (priority-keys first, remaining alphabetical, aliases and tags last), inserting configured default keys when absent.
Alphabetize the values of list properties (aliases, tags, links); keys and non-list values are untouched.
Keep date-created and date-revised current (yyyy-MM-dd): created set on first lint, revised bumped only when other content changed.
Insert required note-type frontmatter keys with their schema defaults when absent; existing values are never overwritten.
Order frontmatter keys by the note-type key-order, then the global default order (domain, category, sub-category, date-created, date-revised, remaining alphabetical, aliases and tags last).
Set the created date key on first lint when absent and bump the revised date key only when the run changed other content.
Report note-type frontmatter violations: enum constraints, nested maps in managed keys, and missing required keys without defaults.
Keep the first H1 equal to the filename stem, rewriting it in place or inserting it after the frontmatter.
Flag filenames that are not kebab-case and propose the compliant name; the rename runs only where rename mode allows it.
Normalize task checkbox spacing and marker case, restrict status characters, write due, scheduled, start, and done dates as yyyy-mm-dd, and keep date tokens in a consistent order.
Apply a case style to inline tags, and report tags that are too deeply nested, not on the allowed list, duplicated in frontmatter, or placed against the preferred location.
Report folder names in the file path that break a case style, the maximum depth, or the allowed names. Report only; needs the file-path option.
Report file names (without extension) that do not match a regex or a preset (kebab, dated). Report only; needs the file-path option.
Report frontmatter that lacks required keys, holds values of the wrong type, or uses values outside an enum. Report only.
Report JSON parse errors with line and column.
Report repeated keys inside one JSON object.
Sort JSON object keys, priority keys first.
Report YAML parse errors with line and column.
Report repeated keys inside one YAML mapping.
Sort top-level YAML keys, priority keys first, keeping comments with their key.
Check required top-level keys and value types.
Function and variable names follow the configured case style for the language.
Report every ERROR and MISSING node of the tree-sitter parse, with line and column.
TODO, FIXME, HACK and XXX comments must carry an owner or an issue.
Comments whose text parses as code in the same language are commented-out code.
Block nesting depth, or subquery and CASE depth in SQL, stays within `max` (default 4).
Lines per function or method, or per SQL statement, stay within `max` (default 60).
